tts_summary: Hey there! Thor is at that spirited four‑month stage where Pugs are playful, food‑motivated, and curious — their squashed faces make them charming but also prone to overheating. Right now he's teething, soaking up socialization, and ready for focused leash and potty training; chat with your vet about his vaccine series if you haven't already, and it's worth discussing spay/neuter timing as he nears six months. Apartment life means lots of short walks and mental enrichment to burn energy, and Thor's strong chewing and dental care matter now. The recommendations below focus on small‑breed kibble, training treats, waste bags, and a cooling pad to keep Thor safe and stocked. Check out the details below to get started.
